content:
raj_pat: hey team, started seeing a regression after today's rollout — our tool calls are either not happening or getting wrong args. started around 10:22am PST for tenant acme.

raj_pat: example: we call the chat API with tools=[{name: "search", args: {query: string}}], and before the rollout the model returned a JSON tool call like:

```
{"tool_call": {"name": "search", "args": {"query": "best laptops 2026"}}}
```

raj_pat: now we get either plain text or a tool call with args renamed to `q` (our service rejects that). sample response below.

raj_pat: request (redwood-go-sdk v0.9.2):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{"model":"redwood-v1.3.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"find best laptops"}],"tools":[{"name":"search","parameters":{"query":{"type":"string"}}}],"tool_calling":"auto"}
```

raj_pat: response we got:
```
{"id":"resp_abc123","choices":[{"message":{"content":"\nI think the best laptops are..."}}]}
```

raj_pat: or sometimes:
```
{"choices":[{"message":{"tool_call":{"name":"search","args":{"q":"best laptops 2026"}}}}]}
```

raj_pat: expected `args.query` but seeing `args.q` or nothing. this started right after the rolloutid=rollout-2026-03-15-1010 (per our telemetry).

maya_support: hi @raj_pat — thanks for the detailed repro, really helpful. can you paste one complete request/response pair including headers + the x-request-id from the response? also which model variant are you pinned to (if any)? will escalate to eng after getting those. :wave:

raj_pat: here's one with headers and request-id:
```
x-request-id: req_98765
Authorization: Bearer ***REDACTED***
User-Agent: redwood-go/0.9.2

Request body: (same as above, model redwood-v1.3.1)
Response body: {"id":"resp_abc123","choices":[{"message":{"tool_call":{"name":"search","args":{"q":"best laptops 2026"}}}}]}
```

maya_support: ok copying to eng. can you confirm also if you saw any errors in your side (400/422) or if this only causes downstream mismatch errors? any rate increases?

raj_pat: no 4xx from us — just our tool invocation parsing fails. looks like our parser expects args.query to exist and rejects unknown keys.

deploy-bot: rollout finished: rollout-2026-03-15-1010 -> 100% traffic. component: model-adapter-service, version: model-adapter-v2.1.4, commit: ab12cd34, started: 2026-03-15T09:45:00Z, completed: 2026-03-15T10:05:12Z

jordan_sre: thanks @maya and @raj_pat — pinging @logan_eng to check model-adapter changes. looks like the adapter handles function/tool calling serialization.

logan_eng: seeing this thread. quick summary from logs: the ab12cd34 change canonicalizes function args to a short form when parameter names are single tokens (e.g., `query` -> `q`) to reduce tokenization cost. seems like it slipped through tests. reproducing locally now.

logan_eng: repro steps I'm using: same request as above against staging with adapter v2.1.4; I get args.q instead of args.query.

maya_support: would pinning to redwood-v1.3.0 help as a temporary workaround? raj, are you able to pin?

raj_pat: we can pin, but we'd prefer a fast fix since pinning requires internal rollout on our side. also worried about repeat regressions.

logan_eng: immediate options:
- roll back model-adapter to v2.1.3 on the infra side (need eng-oncall + infra approval)
- provide tenant routing to previous variant for acme (we can do this from the console)
- server-side compatibility flag `function_serialization=legacy` (we can push a hotfix to honor this flag)

logan_eng: root-cause: a canonicalizer mapping introduced to shorten arg names when type hints are single-word. it was meant to be safe but breaks strict parsers. PR ready to revert: https://git.internal.redwood/rl/repo/pull/4521 (revert ab12cd34), tests failing in one edge-case but fixable. ETA ~2h for hotfix if we prioritize.

maya_support: jordan, can eng-oncall approve rollback to v2.1.3? if not, can we route acme to the previous variant?

jordan_sre: will open an incident and request rollback. routing is faster — maya, can you give raj the route command?

maya_support: yes — run this curl to pin tenant to previous variant (console or API):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/tenants/acme/routing \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>" \
 -d '{"model_variant":"redwood-v1.3.0","reason":"tool-call regression"}'
```

maya_support: I can do it from the console if you want me to.

raj_pat: please do it, that'd be great.

maya_support: done — routed acme -> redwood-v1.3.0. confirmation id: route_5544. can you test now? :white_check_mark:

raj_pat: testing... still seeing occasional `args.q` but much less frequent. maybe some cached hosts or long-running connections. will continue to monitor.

logan_eng: that matches expectation — some backends had warm connections to the new adapter; those will phase out. I'm kicking a hotfix PR now (https://git.internal.redwood/rl/repo/pull/4529) which fully reverts the canonicalizer. will post when merged + deployed.

jordan_sre: opening incident INC-2026-0315-01 and tagging eng-oncall.

raj_pat: quick question — will this cause billing spikes or data exposure? we saw no errors but our parsing failures cause additional retries.

maya_support: billing: likely small bump from retries but we'll monitor. data exposure: no — this is only argument renaming, no payload sent elsewhere. we'll confirm with security if any logs look different.

logan_eng: PR merged to hotfix branch, CI passed for mainline tests, deploying to canary now. commit: de9f1a7. ETA: canary in 15m, full roll in 45m if no regressions.

deploy-bot: deployment started: hotfix/decanonicalize -> canary (component: model-adapter-service, commit: de9f1a7).

maya_support: raj — once the hotfix is on 100% we'll un-route you if you want. otherwise we can keep your tenant pinned for a few days. suggestions?

raj_pat: please un-route once upstream is stable. thanks for quick turnaround, @maya and @logan. really appreciate it. :clap:

logan_eng: will follow up in ~1h with verification. if anyone sees more `args.q` after that, please post request-id and sample.

jordan_sre: incident severity updated to P2 while we monitor.

maya_support: closing loop for now — escalation to eng done, routing applied, hotfix deploying. I'll keep this thread open until 24h after full roll. :lock: 

raj_pat: thanks all. i'll report back if we see more.
